description: This Java class, UpDownSandbox, is a test or demo class for visualizing engine wave data. It parses a report string into an EngineChart, then creates an EngineReport and visualizes it with an UpDownImage inside a Swing JFrame. It appears to be used for testing or debugging engine wave data visualization.
